process.action: Align invisible/transparent target UI elements under decoy content to trick a click

preconditions: A sensitive action page can be rendered inside an iframe with no framing protection (X-Frame-Options/CSP frame-ancestors)

process.expected_observation: Target page renders inside the attacker's iframe
